description: A consortium of European AI research labs and universities continues to deepen its joint framework for sharing non-frontier model evaluations, safety techniques, and defensive cyber tools. The initiative, now including ten institutions across seven countries, has developed an early-warning system for agentic anomalies based on cross-lab pattern recognition, improving detection fidelity. This collaboration operates independently of US-led standards and is increasingly seen as a foundation for EU-specific assurance infrastructure.
